thread:
maria: FYI planning to land kernel v2.18.0 + quant profile q2026-03-01 in the Tue 00:00 UTC change window. need deploybot runbook review + pin criteria.

ajay: timeline ok. are we gating on mem/latency vs preflight numbers?

lucy: preflight in staging looked good, latency median +3ms, p95 +18ms on nvX. but saw KV cache miss spike in one cluster.

samir: saw that too — suspect batching mismatch. I'll run a targeted canary on 2 nodes in night bucket. assigning @deploybot to schedule.

deploybot: deploy scheduled by maria for 2026-03-03T00:00Z to eng-runtime/night. Canary traffic: 0.5% -> 10% over 30m -> 50% over 2h. Rollback threshold: p95 increase >25% OR errors >0.5%.

maria: update release notes: "runtime: kernel v2.18.0 - matmul microkernel ABI changes, quant profile q2026-03-01 (int8 improved)."

ajay: add pin plan: if canary fails, rollback to kernel v2.17.9 and pin quant build to q2026-02-20 for the fleet. Who owns the pin op?

lucy: ops can run pin via:
```
# pin kernel
deployctl pin --component runtime --version v2.17.9 --reason "rollback due canary failures"
# pin quant
deployctl pin --component quant --build q2026-02-20
```

samir: define rollback criteria more specific: p95 > baseline*1.25 sustained for 15m across canary nodes OR new error class "kv-cache:evict" > 5/min.

maria: also add release-note blurb for customers re: minor perf risk during rollout.

ajay: ok. I'll create the post-deploy smoke checklist. assign @opsbot to run smoke scripts and collect traces.

opsbot: smoke run started after canary shift; smoke: gen load 50rps, trace sample id=snap-268345. Logs show "WARN kv-cache-miss 0.04%" on node-3.

lucy: quick check: that WARN is within preflight range. continue.

deploybot: canary progressed to 10% at 00:30Z. metrics: p95 +12%, errors unchanged.

samir: I'm seeing eviction spikes on node-7 at 00:40Z, 7 events in 10m. Initiating canary hold and deep traces.

maria: hold canary. pin plan ready. ops, be prepared to run:
```
deployctl rollback --component runtime --to v2.17.9 --target canary
deployctl pin --component runtime --version v2.17.9 --ttl 12h --reason "eviction spike in canary"
```

opsbot: executed rollback on canary at 00:46Z. confirm: canary nodes back to v2.17.9.

deploybot: canary rollback successful. schedule aborted for ramp. global rollout canceled.

ajay: good call. Need postmortem checklist: investigate batching config, quant profile tuner logs, and add stricter preflight for eviction.

lucy: will open issue ENG-RUNTIME-572 and link smoke traces: https://internal/traces/snap-268345

maria: update release notes to mark release deferred and note pinned versions. sending update to product & cs.

samir: 👍 I'll follow up with deeper trace diff tomorrow.

maria: thanks all — holding release until we iterate on batching/quant. :thumbsup:
